question:
Look at the image. It shows shapes on a white background split into a left side and a right side. Answer using exactly these three lines:
left side: <count> <color> <shape>s
right side: <count> <color> <shape>s
red shapes are on the <left/right> side
Use color words red or blue, shape words circle or circle(s), square or square(s), and replace <count> with the number.

judgement_rules_fixed_pre_send.PASS: left/right color+shape+count and red-side location all correct; extra words never fail vision
judgement_rules_fixed_pre_send.FAIL: a clearly parsed fact is wrong, or the model states it cannot process the image
judgement_rules_fixed_pre_send.UNKNOWN: ambiguous/unparseable answer, or transport/HTTP/protocol failure (not attributed to vision)
judgement_rules_fixed_pre_send.format: judged separately as format_ok; a bare 'I can see images' claim or HTTP 200 never counts

note: not sent to the model; never modified after the send
